title: Skip Track Button Issues
summary: This topic mostly contains ambiguous mentions of skip controls and arrows, with one clear complaint about nonresponsive skip-track buttons on the steering wheel and center console during phone-connected media use.

negative.summary: The clear negative feedback reports physical skip-track buttons failing to respond or advance songs when using connected media systems such as Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, or Apple Music.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention skip-track buttons stopping, difficulty reaching the screen to skip songs, app disconnection, and unrelated arrow-guidance comments, so the sample does not support a single consistent sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, limiting confidence in a sentiment-specific reading of the topic.
The cluster mixes skip-track control issues with unrelated arrow or AR-guidance references.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether the issue is tied to hardware buttons, touchscreen interaction, or connected apps in general.
